phase1-distribution.title: Phase 1: 打通分发
phase1-distribution.description: Security + onboarding + open source release. 让第一批用户能装上、用上 Android Agent。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
GitHub release v0.1-alpha published with signed APK

basic-security.title: 基础 Security Hardening
basic-security.description: 5 项基础安全修复：(1) API key 迁移到 EncryptedSharedPreferences, (2) Manifest cleartext traffic=false + Tailscale HTTPS 配置, (3) InsecureSslConfig 门控为 BuildConfig.DEBUG, (4) allowBackup=false, (5) 加 .env.example。全部是直接实现，不需要额外 design。
acceptCriteria: AppSettingsStore uses EncryptedSharedPreferences for API keys
AndroidManifest usesCleartextTraffic=false
InsecureSslConfig gated behind BuildConfig.DEBUG
AndroidManifest allowBackup=false
.env.example exists in repo root
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

agent-security.title: Agent Security — KISS 4+1 Layer
agent-security.description: 实现 safety_kiss_design.md: Layer 1 AppTier (BLOCKED/CAUTIOUS/NORMAL) + app_tiers.json, Layer 2 perception gate (BLOCKED → mask), Layer 3 execution gate (20 行 PolicyEngine 重写), Layer 4 memory gate, Layer 5 system prompt safety rules + app skill safety sections。删除旧的 per-action risk machinery。
acceptCriteria: AppTier enum exists in protocol/
AppClassifier loads app_tiers.json and classifies packages
BLOCKED app screen is masked before LLM sees it (perception gate)
PolicyEngine.check accepts packageName parameter
BLOCKED app actions denied even in AUTO_APPROVE mode
CAUTIOUS app actions trigger AskUser in SMART mode
remember_experience blocked when foreground app is BLOCKED
Old DEFAULT_RISK_LEVELS and per-action risk code deleted
System prompt contains safety rules
./gradlew test passes

onboarding-wizard.title: Onboarding Wizard
onboarding-wizard.description: 首次启动顺序引导：Accessibility service → Overlay permission → Battery optimization → API key 输入+验证 → Demo task。Phase 0 先做 API key 手动输入，OAuth 是独立 area。
acceptCriteria: First launch shows sequential onboarding flow
Each permission step has clear explanation and action button
API key input validates against LLM endpoint
Demo task runs after setup completes
Subsequent launches skip onboarding
onboarding-wizard.note: Implemented in 2026-04-02. OpenAI OAuth added in subsequent work.

open-source-release.title: Open Source Release
open-source-release.description: README.md + LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING.md + SECURITY.md + .env.example + GitHub Actions CI (build+lint+test on PR) + release workflow (tag → signed APK → GitHub Release)。
acceptCriteria: README.md exists with install guide and quick start
LICENSE file exists (MIT or Apache 2.0)
CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md exist
GitHub Actions CI runs build+lint+test on PR
Release workflow produces signed APK on tag
open-source-release.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase2-utility.title: Phase 2: 真实实用性
phase2-utility.description: Prompt externalization + app skill discovery + eval regression CI。Agent 能在用户日常用的 30+ app 上工作。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
30+ app skills generated via discovery system
Eval runs as CI gate on PRs

prompt-externalization.title: Prompt Externalization
prompt-externalization.description: System prompt 从 StandaloneAgentDef.kt 等硬编码字符串 → assets/persona/<role>/system_prompt.md。新增 PersonaRepository（接口 + asset 实现）。App skill 迭代不再需要重新编译 APK。对应 OpenClaw roadmap P3 Phase 1。是 app skill discovery 的前置条件。
acceptCriteria: System prompt loaded from assets/persona/standalone/system_prompt.md
PersonaRepository interface + AssetPersonaRepository implementation exist
AgentDef subclasses use PersonaRepository instead of inline strings
Changing asset file changes agent behavior without APK rebuild
./gradlew test passes
prompt-externalization.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

app-skill-discovery.title: App Skill Discovery 系统
app-skill-discovery.description: 建一个系统让 agent 自己探索 app 并提炼 SKILL.md（含 Safety section）。Discovery loop: 给定 target app → agent 启动 → 系统性探索 UI 路径 → 记录 a11y tree 特征、navigation pattern、pitfall → 生成 SKILL.md draft。英文市场 top 30 app 优先。需要 quality gate（跑 test task / 人工 review）。
acceptCriteria: Discovery system can generate SKILL.md for a given target app
Generated SKILL.md includes ## Safety section
At least 20 new app skills generated and reviewed
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
app-skill-discovery.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

eval-regression-ci.title: Eval 转 Regression CI
eval-regression-ci.description: AndroidWorld full set 作为 regression gate。PR 跑 eval，regression 才 fail。停止 autotune optimization loop（R58 是最后一轮主动优化）。保留 eval infra 不变。
acceptCriteria: CI workflow runs eval on PR
Eval regression detected and reported as CI failure
Eval pass/fail threshold configured based on R58 baseline
eval-regression-ci.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase3-daily-assistant.title: Phase 3: 日常助手
phase3-daily-assistant.description: Scheduled tasks + notification handling + OpenAI OAuth。把 Android Agent 从一次性工具变成每天都用的 assistant。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done

scheduled-tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled-tasks.description: Cron 式定时任务执行。用户设定 schedule + natural language instruction。AlarmManager/WorkManager 触发 → 启动 agent session → 执行 → 记录结果。UI: 任务列表、创建/编辑/删除、执行历史。
acceptCriteria: User can create a scheduled task with cron expression and instruction
Tasks execute on schedule via WorkManager/AlarmManager
Execution results recorded and viewable
Failed tasks show error and can be retried
scheduled-tasks.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

notification-handling.title: Notification Handling
notification-handling.description: NotificationListenerService 监听 → 按用户定义的规则触发 agent 响应。规则引擎：app filter + keyword filter + sender filter → trigger action。用户 explicit opt-in 每条规则。
acceptCriteria: NotificationListenerService captures notifications
User can create filter rules (app, keyword, sender)
Matching notifications trigger agent task execution
Each rule requires explicit user opt-in
notification-handling.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

openai-oauth.title: OpenAI OAuth Login
openai-oauth.description: 参考 OpenClaw 实现：OpenAI Codex OAuth flow。用户用 OpenAI 账号登录 → 复用已有 subscription。和手动 API key 并存。降低新用户 onboarding friction。
acceptCriteria: OAuth login flow implemented for OpenAI
User can authenticate via OpenAI account
Falls back to manual API key entry
Token refresh handled automatically
openai-oauth.note: OAuth login + CodexResponseClient implemented. Settings integration is a separate task.

settings-restructure.title: Settings Page Restructure
settings-restructure.description: Two-level settings navigation with 3-tab LLM & Auth page. Split manual OpenAI key from OAuth token. Shared OAuth suspend helpers. Provider-linked model filtering.
acceptCriteria: All 8 child tasks done
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

sr-scaffold.title: Settings Scaffold
sr-scaffold.description: Split SettingsSheet.kt into shell + page composables. Add SettingsPage enum (HOME, LLM_AUTH, AGENT_BEHAVIOR, PERMISSIONS_ADVANCED), SettingsNavigationRow, SettingsSubPageHeader, AnimatedContent page switching with directional horizontal slides. Home page has 3 nav rows + version footer.
acceptCriteria: Home and three sub-pages render
back/close behavior works
no settings UI file exceeds 400 lines
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sr-credential-split.title: OpenAI Credential Split and Migration
sr-credential-split.description: Split manual OpenAI key and OpenAI OAuth token in AppSettingsState. Update buildApiKeys() to select active credential. Add one-time migration for legacy installs where OAuth token was saved as manual key.
acceptCriteria: manual OpenAI key survives OAuth sign-in/sign-out
buildApiKeys() selects correct credential based on authMethod
legacy migration clears OAuth artifact from manual-key slot
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sr-shared-oauth.title: Shared OAuth Reuse
sr-shared-oauth.description: Extract reusable OpenAI OAuth flow from OnboardingViewModel into shared suspend helpers under auth/. Wire helpers into both onboarding and settings. Move token refresh under same shared helper layer.
acceptCriteria: onboarding behavior remains unchanged
settings can sign in, cancel, sign out, and refresh through shared helpers
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

sr-llm-tabs.title: LLM & Auth Tab Structure
sr-llm-tabs.description: LlmAuthSettingsPage.kt with TabRow (Sign In / API Key / Local). LlmAuthTab enum. Tab content: Sign In → model dropdowns + placeholder auth card, API Key → model dropdown + key field, Local → local model dropdown + status. Tab switching immediately persists backend/authMethod.
acceptCriteria: three tabs render and switch correctly
tab selection persists backend/authMethod immediately
initial tab reflects current durable state
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sr-provider-filter.title: API Key Provider Selector and Model Filtering
sr-provider-filter.description: SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for provider sub-selector in API Key tab. Provider-linked model catalog filtering. Provider-linked single API key field. ModelCatalog helpers: modelsFor(provider, api?), preferredModelFor(provider, api?). Model/executor canonicalization on provider switch.
acceptCriteria: switching provider updates model dropdown to that providers models
shows only the matching API key field
invalid main/executor models are canonicalized
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sr-auth-card.title: OpenAI Auth Card (Sign In Tab)
sr-auth-card.description: OpenAiAuthCard.kt composable for all four OAuth UI states (SignedOut/InProgress/SignedIn/Error). Wire onStartOAuth, onCancelOAuth, onSignOut from MainActivity through MainActivityContent. Sign In tab shows OpenAI RESPONSE models only + auth card.
acceptCriteria: auth card shows correct state for all four OAuth states
sign out clears OAuth but preserves manual key
sign in launches browser OAuth flow
on success card shows email
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sr-behavior-permissions.title: Agent Behavior and Permissions Pages
sr-behavior-permissions.description: Regroup existing controls into AgentBehaviorSettingsPage (max turns, agent mode, perception mode) and PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage (a11y, overlay, debug toggle). Move PerceptionModeSelector. Wire Home subtitles.
acceptCriteria: existing behavior is preserved
Home subtitle summaries update from live state
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sr-tests.title: Validation and Tests
sr-tests.description: Tests for OpenAI credential selection (manual vs OAuth). Tests for sign-out preserving manual key. Tests for provider-linked model filtering and canonicalization. Tests for migration.
acceptCriteria: new state model is covered by tests
existing cloud/local validation still behaves correctly
./gradlew test passes
